description: This file is a shell script used to generate U-Boot FIT image source (.its) files for multi-image configurations, supporting kernel, device tree, and ramdisk images with various configuration options such as compression, hashing, and signing. It includes functions for constructing the FIT structure, adding images and configurations, and handling command-line arguments.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and script options.

methods.name: array_check
methods.description: Checks if array references are within valid bounds for images or configurations.

methods.name: array_put
methods.description: Sets a value in a named array at a specified index, optionally appending.

methods.name: array_get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a named array at a specified index.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to configure image and configuration parameters.

methods.name: value_sanity_chk
methods.description: Validates signature, hash, and compression options against allowed values.

methods.name: emit_its
methods.description: Generates sections of the .its file, such as header, image nodes, configuration nodes, and section ends.

methods.name: emit_kernel
methods.description: Constructs a kernel image node for the FIT description.

methods.name: emit_fdt
methods.description: Constructs a device tree blob (FDT) image node for the FIT description.

methods.name: emit_ramdisk
methods.description: Constructs a ramdisk image node for the FIT description.

methods.name: emit_cksum
methods.description: Generates checksum subnodes for image data integrity.

methods.name: emit_signature
methods.description: Generates signature subnodes for secure boot and verification.

methods.name: emit_config
methods.description: Constructs configuration subnodes for different boot options within the FIT.

methods.name: remove_prefix_space
methods.description: Removes leading spaces from a string.

methods.name: emit_image_nodes
methods.description: Generates all image nodes (kernel, fdt, ramdisk) and their associated subnodes.

methods.name: emit_configuration_nodes
methods.description: Generates configuration nodes for the FIT image based on parsed configuration data.
